notice.estimateDedup: Unique visitors is an estimate: the same person from a different angle or wearing a mask can be counted twice. "Visits" doesn't rely on de-duplication and is more stable. Only stores with counting enabled are included; staff are excluded.
notice.estimatePlain: "Visits" includes same-day repeat visits and excludes staff; only stores with counting enabled are included. This store has de-duplication off, so unique visitors aren't shown.

basis.timezone: Times use the store's time zone ({{zone}}); daylight-saving changeover days have one hour fewer / more.
